name: SOEdit
steps: Models page: /models/soedit locate (Get SOEdit and open it downloads the latest release when there is none)
Stage the mod model with /models/soedit stage
back: Saved files stay in the mod folder; run Art check

name: Blender with GEM2 Engine Tools add-on
what: Make or change meshes, skinning and animations and export .ply/.mdl/.anm
steps: Import the model, keep bone and part names
Keep at most 65535 vertices per part and 25 skin bones per part
Export with copy textures on and ship every .mtl
back: Export into the mod folder; Art check

name: GEMImport / PLY2FBX / DEF2FBX / Blender-GOH-Gem-Exporter
what: Convert game models to common formats and back
steps: Convert, edit in a 3D editor, export back

name: MoW PLY Tweaker
what: Small edits to .ply parts and material names
steps: Open the .ply from the mod folder

name: DDS image editor (NVIDIA Texture Tools Exporter, Intel Texture Works for Photoshop, DDS Plugin for Photoshop)
what: Write .dds textures (DXT1 no alpha, DXT5 alpha) with mips
steps: Art: /art/copy the vanilla texture into the mod
Paint, keep the same size (divisible by 4, power of two)
Save DXT1/DXT3/DXT5 with mips; never DX10 or BC5
back: File lands in the mod folder; Art check; View picture

name: Nobu's Texture Batch Converter
what: Convert many images to DDS at once

name: NormalMap-Online / Materialize
what: Make bump (normal) and specular maps from a diffuse
steps: Save as DDS with a DDS editor

name: Image editor (any, PNG/TGA)
what: Draw card, portrait and squad pictures
steps: Export PNG at the vanilla size (unit_icon 104x52, unit_icon_small 112x48, portrait 97x135, squad 48x48)

name: Icon Editor (community)
steps: Save TGA into interface/scene/unit_icon of the mod

name: Audacity (audio editor)
steps: Export WAV mono 44100 Hz, PCM16 or IMA ADPCM
Save under sound/<folder>/ of the mod

name: Notepad++ with the ARSENAL pack
what: Edit .mtl, .def, folder.set, sound.set, breed text files
steps: Install the pack from tools/ide (Notepad++ closed)
back: Save in the mod folder; Art check

name: Game editor (as64_ed / mowas_2_ed)
what: Place the unit on a map, look at it in game light and seasons
steps: Start the editor with the mod
